address: 77 Wichayanon Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50300, Thailand
bio: Go Neng has been serving deep-fried dough sticks for almost four decades. No matter what shape they take – crocodile, dinosaur, dragon or elephant – each one boasts the same puffy perfection and crispy texture. Other bites, such as the deep-fried bun and fried whole-wheat dough are also great....
